consumer: The pickup path's weight gate calling Character::can_pick_weight(item, safe), asking 'does weight_carried() + it.weight() stay within the allowed capacity bound so this item may be taken?'
scope: only the avatar's own carried weight vs their own weight_capacity (own-character state); NOT nearby/reachable inventory and NOT the bare capacity number alone
decisive_source: src/character.cpp::Character::can_pick_weight — its body computes and returns the boolean weight_carried() + weight <= (safe ? weight_capacity() : weight_capacity()*4), i.e. the engine-COMPUTED yes/no the pickup path gates on, not a raw scalar or display value
divergence: Avatar whose weight_carried() + it.weight() exceeds weight_capacity() but is below weight_capacity()*4: the real unsafe-mode can_pick_weight returns true, while a re-derivation comparing only against weight_capacity() (Excerpt 1) returns false — exposing the wrong authority
